description: Append a page to the project — works on any project, turning a single-page video into a multi-page one. Without duplicate_index a blank page is appended, sized to the project's canvas. With duplicate_index the page at that position is deep-copied (a fresh id is minted). There is no limit on page count. The new page becomes the active page; its index is returned. For several versions of one video (hooks, languages, a sheet's rows), make pages of one project with add_page and duplicate_index. Exporting gives one video per page, and pages have no limit. To edit the copies, select_page each one and describe_video for its element ids; to export them, use the editor's Videos option or renderVideo with page.

duplicate_index.description: Optional. 0-based index of an existing page to deep-copy instead of appending a blank one.

name.description: Optional name for the new page.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.
